note: Whole store: 118 designer collections, 2,386 styles, own label included. Garments by the store's own product type (blouse = top, blouse, shirt; sweater excludes cardigans; dress excludes gowns, which the store files separately). Low = cheapest style not marked down; high = highest pre-markdown price, so a marked-down style can be the high. Excluded from all figures: any style whose name, address or tags say capsule, collab, archive, vintage, unique or Levi's (Levi's x sacai). Outerwear also excludes leather and suede. MEDIAN full-price: blouse $890 (n=178), sweater $780 (n=87); 90th percentile blouse $1,950, sweater $2,200. Other medians: tee $105, jeans $620, trousers $960, dress $1,490, outerwear $2,250, shoes $1,020. Several lows are the store's own label (tee $95, trousers $315): third-party-only lows are higher. Trousers high is leather pants (the leather rule was written for outerwear only; next non-leather high not computed). Tee high is an Alaïa knit top the store files as a tee, on markdown from $1,200. Outerwear low (Dodiee fringe bolero) not checked for suede. 537 styles carry a 'consignment' price tag; these look like new stock (a raffia bag, sold out) and were kept, not verified.
